replacements.label: Hero description
replacements.find: A book can become a doorway to identity, formation, maturity, and faithful service. Sponsor a copy—or a group of copies—for someone who may not otherwise receive this discipleship resource.
replacements.value: A book can become a doorway to identity, formation, maturity, and faithful service. Sponsor a copy—or a group of copies—for someone who may not otherwise receive this discipleship resource.

replacements.label: Why Give heading
replacements.find: Help Someone Begin a Spiritual Formation Journey
replacements.value: Help Someone Begin a Spiritual Formation Journey

replacements.label: Why Give description
replacements.find: The Divine Blueprint is designed to help readers understand God’s work of making, maturing, and manifesting His sons. Every copy includes access to the digital Companion Journal so the reader can reflect, pray, and apply each chapter.
replacements.value: The Divine Blueprint is designed to help readers understand God’s work of making, maturing, and manifesting His sons. Every copy includes access to the digital Companion Journal so the reader can reflect, pray, and apply each chapter.

replacements.label: Benefit 1 text
replacements.find: Place a copy directly in the hands of a student, young believer, ministry leader, friend, family member, or someone beginning again.
replacements.value: Place a copy directly in the hands of a student, young believer, ministry leader, friend, family member, or someone beginning again.

replacements.label: Benefit 2 text
replacements.find: Sponsor a ten-copy pack for a discipleship group, campus fellowship, leadership circle, or community Bible study.
replacements.value: Sponsor a ten-copy pack for a discipleship group, campus fellowship, leadership circle, or community Bible study.

replacements.label: Benefit 3 text
replacements.find: Help a church, school, prison ministry, mission, rehabilitation program, or outreach organization lead a shared journey.
replacements.value: Help a church, school, prison ministry, mission, rehabilitation program, or outreach organization lead a shared journey.

replacements.label: Benefit 4 text
replacements.find: Coordinate a larger distribution campaign with controlled batch printing, recipient verification, delivery planning, and impact follow-up.
replacements.value: Coordinate a larger distribution campaign with controlled batch printing, recipient verification, delivery planning, and impact follow-up.
